value.rationale: The September 2026 complete classification makes it natural to determine which of its permutations lie in the alternating subgroup, a structural invariant not fixed by the number of bijective binomials. The exact per-coefficient sign law and universal strict bias of magnitude (q^e-1)/(q-1) reveal that the two parity populations are never equal. The result determines an infinite entire natural class rather than a small arbitrary table or rebranding of a lemma. It provides explicit classes with all even or all odd permutations at q=3 and opposite biases for two admissible exponents at q=5; it does not claim broader group structure.
